settings.heading: Frequently asked questions
settings.text: Everything about sizes, offers, delivery and exchanges. Can't find your answer? We reply within a few hours.

settings.question: How does the Buy 2 / Buy 3 offer work?
settings.answer: Add any 2 tees to get 10% off, any 3 to get 15% off, or 5+ to get 20% off. Mix and match designs, colours and sizes. The discount is applied automatically at checkout.

settings.question: What do the Japanese words on the tees mean?
settings.answer: Every design shows its kanji, meaning and haiku on the product page, for example 浪人 Rōnin, the masterless warrior, or 義 Gi, rectitude. All Japanese text is checked by a native speaker before printing.

settings.question: What size should I buy?
settings.answer: Our oversized tees are cut roomy with a drop shoulder. Take your usual size for the intended oversized look, or one size down for a closer fit. See the size guide for exact measurements.

settings.question: Is Cash on Delivery available?
settings.answer: Yes, COD is available across India. Prepaid orders (UPI, cards, net banking) get an extra ₹50 off.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Orders are dispatched within 24–48 hours and delivered in 3–7 working days depending on your pincode. Metro cities usually get it in 2–4 days.

settings.question: How do I track my order?
settings.answer: You get a tracking link on SMS, WhatsApp and email once your order ships. You can also use our track order page.

settings.question: Can I exchange or return my tee?
settings.answer: Yes. Size exchanges are free within 7 days of delivery on unworn tees with tags intact. Damaged or wrong items are replaced or refunded. Details on our returns & exchanges page.

settings.question: What is the fabric and how do I wash it?
settings.answer: 240 GSM, 100% combed cotton, bio-washed and pre-shrunk. Wash inside out in cold water, don't bleach, dry in shade and don't iron directly on the print.

settings.question: Will the print crack or fade?
settings.answer: We use high-density screen, puff and DTF prints tested for 50+ washes. Washing inside out in cold water keeps the print sharp for years.

settings.question: Can I cancel or change my order?
settings.answer: Message us within 12 hours of ordering and before dispatch, and we'll change the size or cancel it for you.

settings.question: Do you ship outside India?
settings.answer: Right now we ship across India only. International shipping is coming soon.

settings.question: How do I win discounts in Dojo Run?
settings.answer: Play the samurai game on our home page. Reach 300, 600 or 1000 points to unlock 5%, 10% or 15% off. One reward per customer.
